howth peninsula heritage society a talk in st. mary’s church of ireland, (beside howth castle main entrance) 8pm tuesday. 27th october 2026 eve gore-booth: irish radical poet and reformer . from lissadell house to industrial manchester, tracing a radical life at odds with an aristocratic heritage. the speaker is sonja tiernan, author and editor of 12 books including the bestselling volumes irish women’s speeches and the biography on eva gore-booth. admission for non members is €5. all are welcome. blessing of the graves mass for all those buried in the two cemeteries in the parish (saint mary’s and old abbey) will take place on sunday 1st november in the church at 11.30am . the blessing of the graves in both cemeteries will take place after the mass. contratulations to beann eadair congratulations to the beann eadair senior men’s football team who bridged a 52 year gap when winning the dublin county gaa junior championship final on sunday 18th october, they comfortably beat the cornelscourt side geraldines patrick moran’s by 3-20 to 3-10. well done to all involved. condolences to the ben’s ladies team who put up a great fight against the more experienced st peregrine’s in their dublin final but ended up on a final scoreline of 6-11 to 4-6. the scoreline did not reflect the quality of the football played by the howth girls who kept fighting to the end but fell foul to two late goals for the opposition, the girls did howth proud and showed they will improve and achieve greater success in the future. well done to all.
